prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions have been consistently too high across all tests relative to measured results.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign changes, as there is only one test so far.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path copy and redesign changes, with only one test for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish copy and new_screen changes, with only one test for each.
Evidence is still thin for home new_flow and wait_info changes, with only one test for each.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +3.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: +2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: -2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, copy: -3.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Desktop Welcome Spotlight Redesign: Redesign the home welcome screen with a spotlight layout highlighting the desktop pet mascot and explicit instructions on desktop placement. (why: 34.2% drop-off at finish with support tickets indicating users are confused about how to locate or interact with their pet on the desktop screen.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Interactive Pet Habit Preview Screen: Insert a new preview screen before path selection showing animated pet behaviors to engage users early. (why: 23.8% drop-off at path selection with high median and mean times (8s / 514s), suggesting users need clearer context on pet capabilities before picking a creation path.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Save Guarantee Hint: Add an explicit hint explaining that signing in preserves pet memories and prevents data loss upon app restarts. (why: Sign in loses 27.1% of users, and 8 support tickets specifically report missing pets or resets after re-signing in.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Setup Wait Info: Display an accurate time estimate and interactive waiting tips explaining the desktop engine installation. (why: The waiting screen has a high mean time of 2336s and 18.7% drop-off; support reported pets failing to show up or stalling.)
4: [finish, new_screen] Onboarding Completion Quick Tips Screen: Add a final quick tips screen outlining simple mouse actions (drag, right-click, hide) before launching to desktop. (why: Support mailbox received multiple reports from users who were confused about controlling, hiding, or talking to their pet after setup.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Path Selector Clarity Copy: Update headline and body on path selection to set expectations around quick setup versus photo customization. (why: High mean time (514s) indicates hesitation on this screen due to unclear path differences.)
6: [sign_in, layout] Card Layout Sign In Redesign: Reframe the sign-in screen into a centered card layout displaying step progress. (why: 27.1% of overall funnel drops off at sign in, with users spending substantial time before authenticating.)
7: [home, redesign] Split Layout Desktop Loading Screen: Redesign the waiting screen into a split view with progress bar on one side and feature tip carousel on the other. (why: Median wait time is 201s (mean 2336s); keeping users engaged during loading reduces drop-off right before completion.)

scores.note: Finish step has highest drop-off (35.2%) and strong support evidence, but redesigns carry mixed risk and cost.
